dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Pokémon are now returning to this town at an encouraging
pace as well!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,3)>Though, I was still hoping to find some clue as to the
whereabouts of the humans...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Have you noticed anything of that sort?

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah, I was about to say the same thing! That building sure
is hard to miss!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>I’m glad you like my pad! I made it by throwin’ together
random junk I found lyin’ around.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>Anyway, that building there sure is hard to miss!

<$voicel(2,5)>Humans must’ve built that massive thing, right?
<$voicel(2,7)>Looks like it’s in shambles now, but maybe we can explore
it and, like, <$voicel(2,5)>fix it up all nice ’n’ pretty!
<$voicel(2,7)>I bet that’d surprise the humans so much, they’d come
back to check it out!

<$voicel(1,9)>You’re not seriously suggesting we could rebuild that
enormous building with only Pokémon to help?!
<$voicel(1,6)>Do you really think it’s possible?

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>’Course I think it’s possible! You’ve got me ’n’
<$cdef(27)>!
And if
we get
everyone
else
to help
out,
too,
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>it’ll
be a
piece
of cake!

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>...OK, maybe not exactly a piece of cake. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>But I do think we
can get it done if we all work together!

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>...OK, maybe I’m overpromising a bit, callin’ it a piece
of cake. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>But I do think we can get it done if we all
work together!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>Well, there’s no doubt such a huge building would stand
out if we were able to properly rebuild it...
<$voicel(1,5)>I suppose it is possible the humans might notice and
come back.
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Even apart from that, if we Pokémon really COULD rebuild
such a thing all on our own...<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>wouldn’t that be exciting?
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>See, <$cdef(27)>Professor</color>, you get it! Big buildings are AWESOME!

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Well then, I say let’s do it! Let’s all work together and
rebuild that thing!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>That’s what I like to hear! Well then, come on! Let’s go see
what we’ve gotta work with. To the building!
<oneline><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Come, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Let’s follow <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster</color>!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Let’s go scope out that building! Follow me!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>*huff* *puff* Come on... Let’s follow <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster</color>!

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>! You’re good at makin’
paths
and
stuff, right?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>D’you think you could put down a nice path from here all
the way to the building?

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I’m countin’ on you to help get me ’n’ the <$cdef(27)>professor to
that building!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Would you please build us a path so we can cross over to
that building?

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Could ya make a nice path all the way to the building?
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Then we can all head to the building together!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Heck yeah, we made it! I knew I could count on
you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>Now then, let’s have a look inside this building!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>Come on! Let’s go check out what’s inside this building!

*bzzz zzzt*
There’s an obstruction in front of the gate!
For safety reasons, the gate will remain closed!

*beep beep beep*
The obstruction in front of the gate has been removed.

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Thanks for helping with the town,
<$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>I just thought of another way to make it even nicer here!

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Well, um, how about building houses here in this town—
houses like the humans had?
<$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,9)>I heard you can do that if you have something called a
<$cdef(27)>building kit!

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Well, um, how about building houses here in this town—
houses like the humans had?
<$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,9)><$kfacial(4)>I heard you can do that if you have something called a
<$cdef(27)>building kit!

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>So if you have a<$cdef(27)> building kit, could you build a house
around here?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Come get me when you’re doing it and I’ll help too!

Don’t forget to put <$cdef(27)>three types of furniture in the house
after you’ve built it!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)><$kfacial(4)>If you have a <$cdef(27)>building kit, could you please build a house
around here?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Come get me when you’re doing it and I’ll help too!

Don’t forget to put <$cdef(27)>three types of furniture in the house
after you’ve built it!

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Oooh, you made a house! Now this place looks more like
a real town, don’tcha think? <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Thank you so much!
